description: Formats a MapLibre style with the keys in the order of the style specification and two space indentation, the same way as gl-style-format. A style given as a file path is formatted in place, otherwise the formatted JSON is returned.

path.description: Path to a style JSON file, relative to the directory the server runs in.

style.description: The style as a JSON object.

url.description: URL of a style JSON document.

name: format_style
title: Format style
